reason: I don't have money for a monthly subscription. My parents pay for everything, and asking them for INR 299 every month for a website I haven't proven is a hard conversation to start. The free tier is fine for now, and I'd rather spend my effort on LeetCode than on a paid mentor.
objection: Nothing counts as progress unless it's checked, and hidden-test judging isn't out yet. I judge tools by the quality of the problems and the judge, and I can't tell yet whether this is better than the free stuff I already use.
would_change_my_mind: A free trial of the AI mentor and resume scoring that clearly beats what I already get for free, or a Pro price I can justify to my parents without a fight.
